name: Cordyceps militaris
summary: Grown on supplemented grain/rice, not logs. Wants 12/12 light once orange initials show.
chamber_notes: This profile only sets climate. Media (brown rice + silkworm-pupa or vegan analog) is on you. Keep jars or trays in the chamber.

source_notes.title: Published cultivation
source_notes.detail: Peer-reviewed and grower protocols commonly use 18 to 22 °C dark spawn, then 16 to 20 °C and 12/12 light for stroma.

source_notes.title: Practice
source_notes.detail: 80 to 90% humidity is enough; pooling water on rice drowns primordia.

stages.name: Colonization
stages.notes: Dark. Do not start light until the surface is colonized.

stages.name: Orange initials
stages.notes: Bright, cooler light helps stroma form.

light_recipe.why: Colonization stays dark. Fruiting uses 12 h and 51% white, mapped from 1250 lux (cordycepin optimum in Wu 2016; 1750 lux gave more dry weight). RGB is blue-heavy from later LED work on compound levels, not from a yield result or a measured spectrum on this strip.
light_recipe.wavelength_note: WS2812 blue is roughly 465 to 475 nm. The RGB mix is an approximation of cited wavelengths, not a measured spectrum.

sources.title: Wu 2016 Cordyceps militaris
sources.detail: Chiu-Yeh Wu et al., Effects of Illumination Pattern during Cultivation of Fruiting Body and Bioactive Compound Production by Cordyceps militaris, Int. J. Med. Mushrooms 18 (2016). Colonization in a spawn room without a stated photoperiod. Primordia and fruiting at 12 h per day. Highest dry yield at 1750 plus or minus 250 lux. Highest cordycepin at 1250 plus or minus 250 lux. This recipe maps 51% white to about 1250 lux.

sources.title: Lin et al. 2024 Cordyceps LED
sources.detail: Yu-Wen Lin et al., Growth of Cordyceps militaris cultivation and its bioactive component accumulation as affected by various single-wavelength LED light sources, International Journal of Food Properties 27 (2024). Single-wavelength LEDs changed bioactive compound levels. This paper is used only for a blue bias, not for a yield or lux number.
